purpose: Canonical executable-style specification for generating the user's daily JLPT N1 and AP study set.
prestart_rule: For dates after the preserved 2026-09-01 history and before 2026-09-07, generate nothing for either JLPT or AP: no daily files, no SQL, no index entry, and no used-word update.
generation_order: read daily-index and recent daily files
incorporate D1 wrong answers/review due/mastery when available
generate JLPT daily_words and daily content
present the resulting study set to the user

session_order: review due from 1/3/7/14/30/60/90/180-day intervals and unresolved wrong answers
2 grammar points with one confirmation question each

display_rules.word_numbering: Every review/new word shown in daily study must display its sequence number. New daily words use 1..N in daily order; review lists use their displayed list order unless a stable curriculum number is available.
paginate: long concept/question lists when item count exceeds page size

date_navigation.calendar_click_behavior: Selecting a calendar date must load and display that date's full daily study set on the same study page.
date_navigation.shared_selected_date: Top date picker, previous/next controls, today button, and calendar all update the same selected study date.
date_navigation.missing_date_behavior: Show that no study data exists for the selected date instead of silently falling back to today.

jlpt.wrong_answer_rule: Wrong or uncertain items return to review before optional new drills. Review questions should normally change context/stem/options.

session_order: due review and unresolved wrong answers

question_style.subject_a: 4-choice exam-style questions with concise explanation of why the answer is correct and why key distractors are wrong
question_style.subject_b: scenario-based practical reasoning; answer using evidence and terms from the scenario

adaptive_rules.accuracy_below_60: reduce new material about 25% and increase review/re-teaching
adaptive_rules.accuracy_60_to_79: keep normal new volume and add focused review
adaptive_rules.accuracy_80_or_above: keep normal volume and advance curriculum
adaptive_rules.same_topic_wrong_three_times: force concept re-teach before more advanced questions
adaptive_rules.missed_day: do not double workload; roll reviews forward and retain new-content backlog

sql_rules.goal: User can git pull and apply only that day's SQL to register today's learning data.

chat_delivery.after_submission: grade, explain mistakes, and feed wrong/uncertain items into later review
